data.name: 霸世狂刀
data.detailed_description:
Overlord Blade Overlord Blade is a vertical idle roguelite slash game. Enjoy auto-battles with an easy learning curve, and experience the thrill of slashing and defeating hordes of monsters.

Step into the fantasy Trial Continent and embark on an epic adventure. Face endless waves of monsters in trial stages. Battles start automatically, unleashing sharp blade strikes to cut down foes in one sweep. Gather resources from combat to upgrade your hero stats, boosting Attack, HP and HP Regeneration. Grow stronger steadily to take on tougher enemies.

Rich adventures await you. Progress through layered trial stages starting from Trial 1-1, unlocking harder dungeons as you advance. Pet, Skill and Summon systems will become available along your journey. Collect powerful pets, unlock unique skills and build your own battle strategy. Earn constant rewards from daily quests, 7-day sign-in bonuses and lucky wheel events. Combine dungeon runs with character growth to accumulate resources and sharpen your blade power.

Fully idle gameplay frees your hands. No complicated controls needed, you can progress your adventure while AFK. Hone your blade skills through countless trials, grow stronger, and dominate this fantasy continent with your mighty blade.

data.short_description: 《霸世狂刀》今日携雷霆之势震撼开服！这是一款颠覆传统、重塑热血的传奇巨作，无套路、无暗坑，只为还原最纯粹的PK快感！💥 刀光剑影中，谁将问鼎巅峰？即刻登录，开启你的霸世征途！
